item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wants to make a working battery for her torch using two cells in a holder at home.
Which arrangement of the two cells will make the torch light up?

options.A: the positive terminal of the first cell touching the positive terminal of the second cell
options.B: the positive terminal of the first cell touching the negative terminal of the second cell
options.C: both cells placed with their positive terminals facing the same end of the holder
options.D: any arrangement, since two cells anywhere in the holder will make a battery
